faq.a: Owl flight feathers have a comb of stiff teeth on the leading edge and a soft fringe on the trailing edge. These break up the air smoothly, so the wings make little of the whooshing noise of other birds.
asks: Why are owl wings so quiet?
What is special about owl wing feathers?

faq.q: Why are owl feathers so soft?
faq.a: The upper surface of owl feathers is covered in fine, velvety down. It muffles the rubbing sound of feathers sliding past each other as the wings move.
asks: Why do owl feathers feel velvety?

faq.q: Why do owls have such big wings?
faq.a: An owl's wings are large for its light body, so it can glide and fly slowly with few wingbeats. Slow flight makes less noise and lets the owl hover over a field while it listens.
asks: How do owls fly so slowly?
Do big wings help owls be quiet?

faq.q: What is an owl's facial disc for?
faq.a: The round dish of feathers on an owl's face works like a satellite dish, gathering faint sounds and funnelling them to the ears, which lie hidden behind the disc.
asks: Why do owls have flat faces?
How do owls hear so well?

faq.a: In barn owls and some others, one ear opening is higher than the other. A sound reaches each ear at slightly different strengths, so the owl can tell up from down as well as left from right.
asks: How do owls find mice in the dark?
Can owls hunt by sound alone?

facts: Owl flight feathers have comb-like serrations on the leading edge and soft fringes on the trailing edge that reduce flight noise.
Barn owls can catch mice in total darkness using hearing alone, helped by asymmetrically placed ears.

quiz.say: Why do owls need silent flight?
quiz.show: Silent flight helps an owl because…

options.show: Prey can't hear it and it can keep listening
options.say: Prey can't hear it and it can keep listening

options.show: It makes the owl fly faster
options.say: It makes the owl fly faster

quiz.why: Quiet wings stop mice hearing the owl and leave the owl's own hearing free to track them.

wrong.1: Owls fly slowly; silence, not speed, is the point.
wrong.2: The feather features are about noise, not warmth.
